title: Iran Israel US war: Stock markets slump over 2% as West Asia war enters 5th week; end FY26 with losses - The Hindu
summary: Indian equities fell sharply due to the ongoing war in West Asia and rising crude oil prices, marking a significant decline in the 2025-26 fiscal year's end. Asian markets also faced downward pressure, while Europe saw marginal gains.
sentiment_reason: The sharp decline in Indian equities and the negative sentiment driven by global uncertainties, rising crude oil prices, and significant outflows of foreign investments indicate a strong negative impact on the market.
